vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Hello, puzzle friends! Today's game is: find the different number!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Numbers? Easy! I'm super fast!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Look carefully. One is different. When the clock ticks, you think!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Ready? Let's go!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle one! Which number is different?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: That one! The first three!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Oops! They are all threes!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: It's the eight! All the others are threes.

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Say it with me: eight!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle two! Find the different number.

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: The one! The others are all fives.

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Say it: one!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle three! Look at the dice. Which one is different?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: This one! It has more dots!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Hmm... no, it has four, like the others.

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: This one has six dots! The others have four. Let's count: one, two, three, four, five, six!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle four! Which group has a different number of apples?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: This group has three apples! The others have two!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle five! Which number is a different color?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: The green seven! The others are red.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle six! Which number is different?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: The big one!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Oh! They are all the same size!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: It's the six! The others are nines. Six and nine look alike, but they are different!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Great thinking! Time to stretch! Jump two times! One, two!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Now clap three times! Clap, clap, clap!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle seven! Count the stars. Which group is different?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: This group has five stars! The others have four.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle eight! Which number is different?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: The two! The others are tens!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle nine! This is tricky. Which one is not number four?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: These all show four: four dots, four fingers, number four. But this one shows five!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle ten! Which basket has a different number of balls?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: This one! It has one ball. The others have three!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Now draw a big number one in the air, with your finger! Down, down, down!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle eleven! Which number is upside down?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: This seven is upside down! Silly seven!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: And now... the super puzzle!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Every number has a twin, except one. Which number is all alone?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Is it... the two?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Good try, Leo! Look again. The two has a twin!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: The nine! It has no twin!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Twelve puzzles! You did it! You are a number superstar!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: One more game! Number riddles!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: I come after one, and before three. What number am I?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Two!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: How many fingers are on one hand?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Five!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: What number comes after nine?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Ten!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Let's count to ten together!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: One!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Two!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Three!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Four!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Five!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Six!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Seven!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Eight!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Nine!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Ten!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Your turn! Count to ten, with your fingers!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Bye-bye, puzzle friends!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: See you next time!
